title: The Front Row Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Front Row is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionTHE FRONT ROWRosemary Beach CommunitySt. Augustine St., Rosemary Beach, FL 32461Home HighlightsFreshly Renovated Condo2 bedrooms plus hallway bunk area (see “Room Details” for layout)2 bathrooms1,191 sq. ft.Sleeps 6 guestsWraparound porch with views of St. Augustine Green and its state-of-the-art amphitheaterFully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar and dining area2-car parking only (per HOA; no extra passes issued)Two 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb excluded; additional rentals available)Step into this sleek, family-friendly condo offering front-row access to Rosemary Beach’s Augustine Green. Enjoy live events at the amphitheater, watch the kids play from the wraparound porch, or relax on plush couches with a large screen TV. Built-in bunks in the hallway make it perfect for up to six guests. The fully equipped kitchen opens to the breakfast bar and dining table, making mealtime a breeze. A short walk takes you to the Cabana Pool and the shops and restaurants of Rosemary Village.Tip: For nearby accommodations for larger groups, check out Emerald Palm, located in the same building.Community AmenitiesExperience the luxury and charm of Rosemary Beach:Four community pools (some heated seasonally)Private beach accessRosemary Square shopping and diningPlayground, parks, and green spacesOutdoor amphitheaterPedestrian and bike paths connecting to Inlet Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys BeachLush landscapingFitness center & racquet club (additional fee)Note: Golf carts are prohibited in Rosemary Beach.ParkingThe Front Row offers two parking passes only; parking is available in the lot behind the building or on-street (first come, first served). Street parking requires a valid permit and is strictly enforced by the HOA. Guests are responsible for any fines or towing.Booking & PoliciesNo smokingPets not allowed (service animals only, with documentation)Published rates do not include taxes or fees50% due at booking; balance due 30 days prior (or in full if within 30 days)Optional travel insurance available; must be purchased before final paymentCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years old
rooms_guidance: Hallway Bunk Area: Bunk Beds (2 Twins)
